messages:
Jin: kicked off an A/B at 2% traffic comparing v6.0-fp32 (control) vs v6.1-mixed8 (treatment). Mixed8 = 8-bit mantissa with per-channel scale; aim is 25-30% token-cost reduction with minimal QoL impact. Initial 1.5k sample now.

Marta: good. any slices breathing worse?

Jin: summary table from live smoke: 
```
slice | ctrl_ROUGE | treat_ROUGE | delta_pct
longform | 0.74 | 0.73 | -1.4%
api-extract | 0.79 | 0.75 | -5.1%
qa-short | 0.70 | 0.68 | -2.8%
conversation | 0.80 | 0.80 | 0.0%
```

Evan: api-extract down 5% is concerning. is it hallucination or schema drift?

Jin: diffs show more field-renaming and occasional token-level substitutions in code-like blocks. hallucination_per1k increases 6 -> 14. Looks like lower precision affects symbol tokens.

Luca: which quant pipeline and runtime flags? any calibration pass?

Jin: pipeline: mixed8 per-channel with affine scaling, post-calibration on a 50k token subset, clamp_strategy=median_clip. runtime flags: parallel-kernel-v3, kv_fp16. seed: 9983. snippet: 
```
quant: mixed8_pchan
affine_scale: true
clamp: median_clip
calib_samples: 50000
seed: 9983
runtime: parallel-kernel-v3
```

Marta: from a rollout-gates POV we want a conservative A/B: hold at 2% and require api-extract delta <3% or manual human pass on top-100 failures before scaling. For automatic fallback, propose a paired-signal rule: fallback if (1) critical_slice_drop > 3% AND (2) hallucination_inc_per1k > 4 within min_samples and window. This reduces noise-induced rollbacks.

Evan: agree. Add a hysteresis so fallback requires condition true for two consecutive windows to avoid flapping. Also include a tie-breaker: if composite_score > threshold for >30m then immediate rollback.

Luca: composite_score idea ok. propose weights: api-extract_drop * 0.5, halluc_per1k_norm * 0.4, user_reject_rate_norm * 0.1. And min_samples_per_slice=2000, window=20m, stable_windows=2.

Jin: drafting auto-fallback YAML: 
```
auto_fallback:
  min_samples_per_slice: 2000
  window: 20m
  stable_windows_required: 2
  triggers:
    - name: critical_slice_drop
      slices: ["api-extract","qa-short"]
      metric: rouge_l_delta_pct
      threshold: -3.0
    - name: hallucination_inc
      metric: hallucination_per1k_abs
      threshold: 4
    - name: composite_score
      metric: composite_norm
      threshold: 0.28
  composite_weights:
    api-extract: 0.5
    hallucination: 0.4
    user_reject: 0.1
  action: fallback_to: v6.0-fp32
```

rollout-bot: A/B report (v6.1-mixed8 vs v6.0-fp32)  traffic=2% (1% each), samples=1500, p50 latency -10% (treatment), p95 -13%, token-cost -27%, fallback_state=not_triggered.

Marta: action items: Jin -> run targeted 20k api-extract sweep and collect top-200 failure artifacts for human triage; Evan -> implement hysteresis check + composite_norm metric in gate engine; Luca -> reproduce mixed8 locally with seed 9983 and run symbol-token sensitivity test; I'll keep canary frozen at current traffic until human triage result.

Evan: small ask  add version_tagging to the rollout metadata so we can replay exact model+quant pipeline if we need to bisect. Also include model_checksum and quant_config_hash.

Jin: done, pushed tags: v6.1-mixed8-2026-03-21, checksum=sha256:abc123..., qc_hash=qc987. Link to eval: https://internal/redwood/evals/v6.1-mixed8/ab-sweep

Marta: ok. decision rule for escalation: move to 5% only if api-extract delta > -3% AND composite_score < 0.2 AND human-triage high-severity errors < 1%. If not, iterate on calibration/clamp.

Luca: will also run a tokenization-aware shim to check symbol encoding differences; sometimes rounding interacts with tokenizer edgecases.

Jin: thanks all, will post results when the 20k sweep finishes (~6h). Keeping this thread as the canonical A/B rollout log. :memo:
